highlights.title: See when an agent sits on one step
highlights.line: A Claude agent's card and page say when it has been on one tool call for five minutes or more, and which tool.

highlights.title: Added agents keep their account and model
highlights.line: An agent you add from Found agents stays on the Claude account and model it was using, and Kosmos says if it could not tell.

highlights.title: The restart note says what was checked
highlights.line: After this computer restarts, the note says how many agents came back, names any that did not, and whether Kosmos's main records read fine.

highlights.title: A little more space in project rooms
highlights.line: Posts in a project room now have slightly more space between lines.

highlights.title: Long agent messages say what they are about
highlights.line: When a long message is saved to a file for an agent, its pane line now shows how it starts and its length.
